tripledip.description: 30% of balance, x3 per losing day, $160k cap. Champion of the 1990-2026 autoresearch run: worst CAGR 8.84% across 5 start years, no bust, survives the 1.25x volatility stress gate on a flat parameter plateau.

tripledip-harvest.description: Income variant of tripledip: same sizing, plus withdraw $25,000 whenever the balance reaches $75,000. 1990-2026 benchmark: 7.99% worst CAGR (vs 8.84% without withdrawals), $350,000 banked across 14 withdrawals, at-risk balance capped near $75k, no busts. Research-only: the live trader has no withdrawal support and refuses this preset.

classic.description: The original fixed-dollar demonstration ladder: $5,000 x2 per losing day, $160k cap. Kept as the martingale failure-mode demo.
